title: [v2.8.2.1-dev-d] Overview and Treatment tab not updated with TBR
body:
Strange issue this morning, just before 11:00 basal shown on overview stopped to be updated (profile basal shown)
- between 10:55 and 13:00 loop worked and several 0% TBR was set continuously by loop plugin (verified on my pump and on Loop plugin)
- in Treatment tab, no records was visible after 10:55
- I tried to set manually 0% TBR from action tab (recorded in UserEntry, but not visible in overview, Action tab and Treatments tab)
- I tried to restart AAPS, reboot my phone, synchronize pump several times without success (no new TBR records in treatment tab and profile basal rate visible in overview)

Finaly I downgraded AAPS to a previous version (2.8.2.1-dev) at about 13:13 and after the pump connexion all informations was updated (see lower right screenshot) (and all TBR done between 10:55 and 13:00 were added in treatment tab)
Back again in dev-d version, now it works.

See screenshots below and log files (beginning and end of issue)

![Screenshot_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/111907464-b8126a80-8a55-11eb-83a5-427deb213b6f.jpg)

When problem started
[AndroidAPS._2021-03-21_00-00-07_.14.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6177542/AndroidAPS._2021-03-21_00-00-07_.14.zip)

When problem disappeared
[AndroidAPS._2021-03-21_13-17-45_.0.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/6177562/AndroidAPS._2021-03-21_13-17-45_.0.zip)

Third sequence of bug (yesterday at about 10:00 PM until this morning)
Pump Insight v3
CGM : G6 with Dexcom Patched App

I can help to find the bug but I need guidance to know where searching. (migration of Insight plugin to module ? database ?)

When the issue starts with dev-d version, it remains with the bug (reboot or restart of AAPS don't solve it)
To recover data the sequence tested is:
- Downgrade to dev version (not tested with intermediate versions from dev-a to dev-c)
- wait for pump synchronization (see screenshots below)
- Update again to 2.8.2.1-dev-d (then it works again for "a while"

![Bug_dev-d](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/112111097-06d61680-8bb4-11eb-9522-f763e0d58392.jpg)
this regression appeared between the dev-c (OK) of March 01 and the dev-d (KO) of March 17... (I hope that update of Insight Driver with room will solve if...)
Fixed by Insight driver and database
